datasets.name: tasksource/ruletaker
datasets.paper: Clark et al. 2020, Transformers as Soft Reasoners over Language, IJCAI 2020, arXiv:2002.05867
datasets.task: logical entailment from natural language rules and facts
datasets.notes: Streamed 50k train + 10k test rows. Full dataset has ~707k examples across train/dev/test. Context contains natural language facts and rules; question is a statement; label is entailment/not_entailment. Config encodes reasoning depth.

datasets.name: tasksource/proofwriter
datasets.paper: Tafjord et al. 2021, ProofWriter: Generating Implications, Proofs, and Abductive Statements over Natural Language, Findings ACL-IJCNLP 2021, arXiv:2012.13048
datasets.task: logical entailment with gold proof traces and proof generation
datasets.notes: Extends RuleTaker with gold proof traces in allProofs field. OWA (Open-World Assumption) version with depths 0-5. The theory field contains all facts+rules in NL. allProofs encodes the proof tree with triple/rule references. Includes Unknown class unlike binary RuleTaker.

datasets.name: tasksource/folio
datasets.paper: Han et al. 2022, FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic, EMNLP 2024, arXiv:2209.00840
datasets.task: FOL-grounded NL reasoning: verify conclusion validity given premises with FOL annotations
datasets.notes: 1430 examples total with gold FOL annotations for both premises and conclusion. Each record has NL premises + FOL translations, making it ideal for text-to-FOL evaluation. FOL correctness verified by an FOL inference engine. GPT-4 still struggles on a subset.

summary.best_for_proof_traces: tasksource/proofwriter (allProofs field with step-by-step proof references)
datasets_discarded: axon-rl/RuleTaker-d5-70k (reformatted as QA, loses structured fields)
